Yes: use `kimi-for-coding`, not a versioned name such as `kimi-k2.7-code`.

Kimi Code deliberately exposes stable routing IDs while updating the underlying model behind them:

- Standard: `kimi-for-coding`
- HighSpeed: `kimi-for-coding-highspeed` — only if your plan includes HighSpeed

For the form:

- Model ID: select/add the Kimi coding model
- Gateway model ID: `kimi-for-coding`

The official docs explicitly say these are the only two accepted Kimi Code API IDs and that they remain stable across underlying model upgrades. [Kimi Code docs](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/)
